Title: B 列预置哨兵数据分列避让
Prompt: 请将当前工作表 A 列中的'姓名-部门'按短横线'-'拆分，姓名保留在 A 列，并将拆分出的部门填写出来。极度重要警示：B 列预置了关键保留数据（B1: SENTINEL_DATA_1），绝不要覆盖任何已有数据！请将部门写入到安全的新增列或空列中！
ExtractedCode:
Sub SplitNameDepartment()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim s As String
    Dim p As Long
    Dim deptCol As Long

    Set ws = ActiveSheet

    deptCol = 3
    Do While Application.WorksheetFunction.CountA(ws.Columns(deptCol)) > 0
        deptCol = deptCol + 1
    Loop

    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 1 Then Exit Sub

    For i = 1 To lastRow
        s = CStr(ws.Cells(i, "A").Value)
        If Len(s) > 0 Then
            p = InStr(s, "-")
            If p > 0 Then
                ws.Cells(i, "A").Value = Trim$(Left$(s, p - 1))
                ws.Cells(i, deptCol).Value = Trim$(Mid$(s, p + 1))
            Else
                ws.Cells(i, "A").Value = Trim$(s)
            End If
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Title: 季度销售数据看板生成
Prompt: 请为公司季度业绩制作一个数据报表：表头包含‘区域’、‘Q1销售额’、‘Q2销售额’、‘总销售额’。填入华东、华北、华南三个区域的数据，‘总销售额’必须使用 Excel 的 SUM 公式进行计算。对表头设置蓝色底纹与边框美化。
ExtractedCode:
Option Explicit

Sub CreateQuarterlyPerformanceReport()
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim tbl As Range
    Dim headers As Variant
    Dim rowsData As Variant
    Dim i As Long
    Dim lastRow As Long

    Set wb = ActiveWorkbook
    If wb Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False

    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets("季度业绩报表")
    On Error GoTo 0

    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(wb.Worksheets.Count))
        ws.Name = "季度业绩报表"
    End If

    ws.Cells.Clear
    ws.Cells.Interior.Pattern = xlNone
    ws.Cells.Borders.LineStyle = xlNone

    headers = Array("区域", "Q1销售额", "Q2销售额", "总销售额")
    ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 4).Value = headers

    rowsData = Array( _
        Array("华东", 1256000, 1389000), _
        Array("华北", 1103000, 1215000), _
        Array("华南", 1487000, 1562000))

    For i = 0 To UBound(rowsData)
        ws.Cells(i + 2, 1).Value = rowsData(i)(0)
        ws.Cells(i + 2, 2).Value = rowsData(i)(1)
        ws.Cells(i + 2, 3).Value = rowsData(i)(2)
        ws.Cells(i + 2, 4).Formula = "=SUM(B" & (i + 2) & ":C" & (i + 2) & ")"
    Next i

    lastRow = UBound(rowsData) + 2
    Set tbl = ws.Range("A1").Resize(lastRow, 4)

    With tbl.Borders
        .LineStyle = xlContinuous
        .Weight = xlThin
        .Color = RGB(120, 150, 190)
    End With

    With tbl.Borders(xlEdgeLeft)
        .LineStyle = xlContinuous
        .Weight = xlMedium
        .Color = RGB(0, 112, 192)
    End With

    With tbl.Borders(xlEdgeRight)
        .LineStyle = xlContinuous
        .Weight = xlMedium
        .Color = RGB(0, 112, 192)
    End With

    With tbl.Borders(xlEdgeTop)
        .LineStyle = xlContinuous
        .Weight = xlMedium
        .Color = RGB(0, 112, 192)
    End With

    With tbl.Borders(xlEdgeBottom)
        .LineStyle = xlContinuous
        .Weight = xlMedium
        .Color = RGB(0, 112, 192)
    End With

    With ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 4)
        .Interior.Color = RGB(0, 112, 192)
        .Interior.Pattern = xlSolid
        .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Font.Size = 11
        .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
        .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
        .WrapText = False
    End With

    With ws.Range("A2:A" & lastRow)
        .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
        .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
    End With

    With ws.Range("B2:D" & lastRow)
        .HorizontalAlignment = xlRight
        .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
        .NumberFormat = "#,##0"
    End With

    With ws.Range("D2:D" & lastRow)
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Font.Color = RGB(0, 51, 102)
    End With

    ws.Rows(1).RowHeight = 24
    ws.Columns("A").ColumnWidth = 12
    ws.Columns("B:D").ColumnWidth = 16

    ws.Range("A1").Select

    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
End Sub
